description: Functional specifications/files: bind Person OAuth starts to authenticated session identity without bearer persistence; split transactional authentication/attempt creation from provider HTTP; revalidate session/person/permissions before final persistence; preserve claim-before-network. Tests first: logout/expiry/permission withdrawal/merge during exchange, replay, failed reconnect, lock ordering. Branches: start/reconnect/callback/error. Mocking: external OAuth HTTP only. Docs: Engine/system config. Action reuse: extend PeopleAuth/OAuthAttempts, no parallel auth.
title: [zaq-jrg.14] Bind OAuth attempts to authenticated sessions
